cards.name: Blaze Spark
cards.effect: When summoned: choose another summon you control in the arena. It gets +2 emission until end of turn.
cards.restriction: Sacrifice this card at the end of the turn. The opponent generates a token as normal.

cards.name: Blaze Striker
cards.effect: None
cards.restriction: −1 capacity while attacking.

cards.name: Blaze Raider
cards.effect: When this sacrifices a summon in battle: place 1 damage on another summon in the opponent's arena.
cards.restriction: Also place 1 damage on another summon in your arena (you choose), if possible.

cards.name: Blaze Charger
cards.effect: When this charges a token on the opponent's Void Altar: +2 emission for that charge.
cards.restriction: When this charges a token on your own Void Altar: −2 emission for that charge.

cards.name: Blaze Duelist
cards.effect: Once per turn, when this attacks a summon and sacrifices it: stand this.
cards.affinity: It also gets +1 emission until end of turn.
cards.restriction: If this is also sacrificed in that battle, sacrifice the top token of your stash.

cards.name: Blaze Titan
cards.effect: Can't charge tokens. When summoned: the opponent chooses a summon in their arena and sacrifices it, if possible. You generate a token as normal.
cards.affinity: You choose the summon instead of the opponent.
cards.restriction: Sacrifice the top token of your stash. The opponent generates a token as normal.

cards.name: Blaze Flare
cards.effect: While this is on the Fragment Recall Altar: your summons in the arena get +1 emission.
cards.restriction: Your summons in the arena also get −1 capacity while this is on the Fragment Recall Altar.

cards.name: Frost Ward
cards.effect: When summoned: choose another summon you control in the arena. It gets +2 capacity until the start of your next turn.
cards.restriction: This gets −1 capacity until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Frost Guard
cards.effect: None
cards.restriction: −1 emission while intercepting.

cards.name: Frost Sentinel
cards.effect: When this intercepts: it gets +2 capacity until end of turn.
cards.affinity: The attacker also gets −1 emission until end of turn.
cards.restriction: This also gets −1 emission until end of turn.

cards.name: Frost Keeper
cards.effect: Once per turn, when this rests: stand it.
cards.affinity: When it stands this way, it gets +1 capacity until end of turn.
cards.restriction: After it stands this way, it can't charge tokens this turn.

cards.name: Frost Bulwark
cards.effect: Can move to intercept more than once per turn.
cards.affinity: Each time this intercepts, the attacker takes 1 damage.
cards.restriction: Each time this intercepts after the first in a turn, it takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Frost Colossus
cards.effect: Can't attack summons. While this is in your arena: your other summons in the back row get +2 capacity.
cards.restriction: Your summons in the front row get −1 emission.

cards.name: Frost Thaw
cards.effect: While this is on the Fragment Recall Altar: the first of your summons in the arena to rest this turn stands.
cards.affinity: The stood summon also gets +1 capacity while this is on the Fragment Recall Altar.
cards.restriction: The effect will fail if spent on a Full card.

cards.name: Seal Fragment
cards.effect: Both players must sacrifice one token from their stash.
cards.affinity: The opponent doesn't generate tokens for your sacrifices.
cards.restriction: You sacrifice 2 tokens instead of 1.

cards.name: Seal Warden
cards.effect: While this is in your arena: when the opponent generates a token, you choose which slot of their Void Altar it goes on.
cards.affinity: That token can't be charged until the end of the opponent's next turn.
cards.restriction: When you generate a token, the opponent chooses which slot of your Void Altar it goes on.

cards.name: Seal Lock
cards.effect: When summoned: choose a token on top of a slot of the opponent's Void Altar. It can't be charged until the end of their next turn.
cards.restriction: The opponent chooses a token on top of a slot of your Void Altar. It can't be charged until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Seal Bastion
cards.effect: Can't charge tokens. While this is in your arena: summons in the opponent's arena can't move, including to intercept.
cards.restriction: Summons in your arena can't move to intercept either.

cards.name: Static Pulse
cards.effect: Once per turn, when you stand your summons: place 1 damage on a summon in the opponent's arena.
cards.restriction: Also place 1 damage on another summon in your arena (you choose), if possible.

cards.name: Static Coil
cards.effect: When this deals damage to a summon: that summon gets −1 capacity until the end of your next turn.
cards.restriction: This also gets −1 capacity until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Static Storm
cards.effect: Once per turn, when you stand your summons: place 1 damage on every summon in the opponent's arena.
cards.affinity: The opponent's summons with damage on them also get −1 emission until end of turn.
cards.restriction: Also place 1 damage on every other summon in your arena.

cards.name: Static Surge
cards.effect: While this is on the Fragment Recall Altar: each time one of your summons deals damage to a summon, place 1 more damage on it.
cards.restriction: Each time one of your summons takes damage, it takes 1 more damage.

cards.name: Flow Runner
cards.effect: Can move to intercept from any slot in your arena, not just the front row.
cards.affinity: After it intercepts and survives, it may move to any empty slot in your arena.
cards.restriction: After it intercepts, it rests.

cards.name: Flow Drifter
cards.effect: Once per turn, during your turn: move one of your summons in the arena to an empty slot it can be placed in.
cards.affinity: You may move one of the opponent's summons in their arena instead.
cards.restriction: Then the opponent may move one of their summons in their arena the same way.

cards.name: Flow Tide
cards.effect: When summoned: move up to 2 summons in the opponent's arena to other empty slots they can be placed in (you choose).
cards.restriction: Then the opponent moves up to 2 summons in your arena the same way.

cards.name: Flow Shift
cards.effect: When placed on the Fragment Recall Altar: move up to 2 of your summons in the arena to empty slots they can be placed in.
cards.affinity: You may move one of the opponent's summons in their arena instead of one of yours.
cards.restriction: Then the opponent moves 1 of your summons in your arena the same way.

cards.name: Hidden Snare
cards.effect: Once per turn, when an opposing summon attacks one of your summons in the arena, you may sacrifice this: the attacker deals 0 damage in that battle. The opponent generates a token as normal.
cards.affinity: The attacker also gets −2 capacity until end of turn.
cards.restriction: The opponent generates 2 tokens for this sacrifice instead of 1.

cards.name: Hidden Tripwire
cards.effect: When an opposing summon attacks a summon in the same column as this: the attacker also takes 2 damage.
cards.restriction: This also takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Hidden Lure
cards.effect: When an opposing summon attacks this: the opponent sacrifices the top token of their stash, if possible. You generate a token as normal.
cards.affinity: The attacker also rests if it was standing.
cards.restriction: You also sacrifice the top token of your stash, if possible. The opponent generates a token as normal.

cards.name: Hidden Ambush
cards.effect: While this is on the Fragment Recall Altar: the first opposing summon to intercept this turn takes 2 damage.
cards.restriction: The attacking summon it intercepted also takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Refract Lens
cards.effect: When summoned: look at the opponent's hand.
cards.affinity: Also look at the top card of their deck.
cards.restriction: The opponent looks at your hand.

cards.name: Refract Prism
cards.effect: When summoned: reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Put 1 in your hand and the other on the bottom.
cards.restriction: The opponent chooses which card you put in your hand.

cards.name: Refract Mirror
cards.effect: When summoned: the opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card from it; they sacrifice it. You generate a token as normal.
cards.restriction: You reveal your hand too. The opponent chooses a card from it and you sacrifice it. The opponent generates a token as normal.

cards.name: Refract Glimpse
cards.effect: When placed on the Fragment Recall Altar: look at the top 3 cards of the opponent's deck, then put them back in any order.
cards.affinity: Also look at the opponent's hand.
cards.restriction: The opponent looks at the top 3 cards of your deck and puts them back in any order.

cards.name: Chaos Rift
cards.effect: Abyss effect. While this is active in the abyss: summons in both arenas get +1 emission.
cards.affinity: Only your summons get the bonus.
cards.restriction: Summons in both arenas also get −1 capacity while this is active.

cards.name: Chaos Recall
cards.effect: When summoned: return a face-up card from your Void Abyss to your hand.
cards.restriction: The opponent returns a face-up card from their Void Abyss to their hand, if possible.

cards.name: Chaos Breaker
cards.effect: When summoned: dissipate the active card or token in the abyss, if there is one.
cards.restriction: Sacrifice this card. The opponent generates a token as normal.

cards.name: Chaos Echo
cards.effect: When placed on the Fragment Recall Altar: put a face-up card from your Void Abyss on top of your deck.
cards.affinity: Put it in your hand instead.
cards.restriction: The opponent puts a face-up card from their Void Abyss on top of their deck, if possible.

tokens.name: Ember Rune
tokens.effect: When this is claimed: choose a summon you control in the arena. It gets +2 emission until end of turn. If there are none, this is spent.

tokens.name: Cinder Rune
tokens.trigger: When this is sacrificed as cost
tokens.effect: When this is sacrificed as cost: the summon you're paying for gets +1 emission until end of turn.

tokens.name: Rime Rune
tokens.trigger: While this is in the stash
tokens.effect: While this is in the stash: your summons in the arena get +1 capacity.

tokens.name: Hoar Rune
tokens.effect: When this is generated: choose a summon you control in the arena. It gets +1 capacity until the start of your next turn. If there are none, this is spent.

tokens.name: Seal Rune
tokens.effect: When this is claimed: choose a token on top of a slot of the opponent's Void Altar. It can't be charged until the end of their next turn. If there are none, this is spent.

tokens.name: Static Rune
tokens.effect: When this is generated: place 1 damage on a summon in the opponent's arena. If there are none, this is spent.

tokens.name: Flow Rune
tokens.effect: When this is claimed: move one of your summons in the arena to an empty slot it can be placed in. If there are none, this is spent.

tokens.name: Hidden Rune
tokens.trigger: While this is in the stash
tokens.effect: While this is in the stash: once per turn, when an opposing summon attacks one of your summons in the arena, the attacker takes 1 damage.

tokens.name: Refract Rune
tokens.effect: When this is claimed: look at the opponent's hand.

tokens.name: Chaos Rune
tokens.trigger: When this is sacrificed as cost
tokens.effect: When this is sacrificed as cost: dissipate the active card or token in the abyss. If there is none, this is spent.
